# Ahmer Institute of Technology (AIT)

> A university website with applicant, student, teacher, staff and admin portals, built in PHP 8 and MySQL 8. Portfolio project: the institute and its people are fictional; the code and security controls are real.

AIT is located (fictionally) on Indus Highway, Jamshoro, Sindh, Pakistan. It offers fifteen bachelor programs across five faculties and runs an online admissions cycle for the Spring 2027 intake.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://ait.ahmershah.dev/): overview, programs, campus, news
- [Programs](https://ait.ahmershah.dev/programs): 15 degrees with duration, credit hours and seats
- [Admissions](https://ait.ahmershah.dev/admissions): process, key dates, eligibility, merit formula (test 50%, HSC 40%, SSC 10%), fees
- [Departments](https://ait.ahmershah.dev/departments): five faculties and their facilities
- [Faculty](https://ait.ahmershah.dev/faculty): teaching staff profiles
- [Campus life](https://ait.ahmershah.dev/campus-life): labs, library, sports, hostels, transport, societies
- [FAQ](https://ait.ahmershah.dev/faq): eligibility, documents, fees, scholarships, hostels
- [Contact](https://ait.ahmershah.dev/contact): admissions office and map

## Portals
- Applicant: /registration, /login, /dashboard
- Enrolled student: /student-login, /student-dashboard
- Teacher: /teachers/login.php
- Staff: /staff/login.php
- Admin: /admin/login.php
